profile.summary: Ambica Agarbathies Aroma & Industries Limited manufactures and sells incense sticks in India and internationally. The company operates through Agarbathies Division and Hotel Division segments. It offers Durbar Bathi, Amrutham, and Athjisaya Dhoop, as well as Dhoop and Sambrani, mosquito repellants, and Pooja products.
